data.name: 如何使用怪物
entries: 每个怪物都是冒险的源泉。在这本《龙与地下城》怪物图鉴中，你将发现奇异、古怪、雄伟和恐怖的生物。选择你最喜欢的怪物，并将它们融入你的 D&D 游戏中。

Along with the {@book 2024年玩家手册|XPHB} and {@book 地下城主指南（2024）|XDMG}, the Monster Manual is part of D&D's foundation and requires those books. This book is intended for Dungeon Masters (DMs) and provides game statistics for monsters: all sorts of creatures—whether friend or foe—controlled by the DM. Those statistics appear in stat blocks. The book presents the monsters' sections alphabetically, with animals gathered in {@book 附录A|XMM|2}. See the index if you need assistance finding a particular monster.

Official D&D adventures refer to the monsters in this book, and you may use these monsters—along with the rules for monster customization and encounter building in the Dungeon Master's Guide—to build your own adventures. Consult {@book 附录 B|XMM|3} for monster lists that will help your adventure building.

entries.name: 2025 版本有什么新内容？
entries: This is the 2025 version of the fifth edition {@i 怪物图鉴}. If you've read the 2014 version, much of this book will feel familiar, since the fundamental rules and variety of monsters are the same. Much of the book contains new or redesigned elements, and the monsters herein replace versions from older books. Here are highlights:

items.name: 更多怪物
items.entry: 怪物的数量已经增加到超过500个属性块。

items.name: 新怪物
items.entry: 数十种新怪物，包括更多高级威胁，已准备好挑战各个级别的角色。

items.name: 精修规则
items.entry: 每个属性数据块都已更新，以便于使用和游戏平衡。

items.name: 增强的统计数据块
items.entry: 新的属性块设计和语言优先考虑游戏中至关重要的细节。

items.name: 多功能团体
items.entry: NPC现在与其他怪物一同出现，可以代表任何类人生物种类的个体。

items.name: 改进的组织
items.entry: 怪物现在按其名称的字母顺序排列。同一怪物的变体被分组在一起。

items.name: 扩展列表
items.entry: {@book 附录 B|XMM|3} collects and expands lists of monster details that appeared in the 2014 {@book 城主指南|DMG|11}.

entries: Every monster in the 2014 {@i 怪物图鉴} appears in this book or has a CR-appropriate replacement detailed in {@book 附录 B|XMM|3|怪物转换}.

entries.name: 属性块概览
entries: 怪物具有一个包含在游戏中使用它所需规则的属性块。属性块分为以下几个部分，与示例属性块——吸血鬼仆从相对应：

items.name: 名称与概述
items.entry: 怪物名称后面跟随其体型、生物类型（以及任何描述性标签）和阵营。

items.name: 战斗亮点
items.entry: {@variantrule 护甲等级|XPHB}, {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, and {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} are provided here.

items.name: 属性值
items.entry: 怪物的属性值、属性调整值和豁免掷骰在此列出。

items.name: 其他细节
items.entry: 怪物的感官、语言和挑战等级（CR）条目显示在此处。部分怪物还会有其他详细信息，例如技能熟练、抗性、免疫和装备。如果怪物缺少这些详细信息，则不会显示相应条目。

items.name: 特性
items.entry: 怪物的特性，无论何时或在特定情况下激活的，都会出现在这里。

items.name: 动作
items.entry: The monster can take the actions here in addition to those in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|动作}.

items.name: 附赠动作
items.entry: 本节提供怪物的奖励动作（如果有的话）。

items.name: 反应与传奇动作
items.entry: 这些部分提供了反应动作和传奇动作（如果有的话）。示例怪物不包括这些部分。

entries.name: 怪物条目
entries: 本书的大部分内容由怪物章节组成，每个章节的标题后包含以下部分。

entries.name: 栖息地
entries: A monster's habitat entry notes where the monster typically dwells. Lists of monsters organized by habitat appear in {@book 附录 B|XMM|3|按栖息地分类的怪物}.

entries.name: 宝藏
entries: 怪物的宝藏条目指定了怪物是否囤积宝藏以及它们偏好的宝藏类型。这些偏好如下：

items.name: 任何
items.entry: 怪物的财宝堆中可以包括货币财宝和各种魔法物品。

items.name: 梅尔奇斯雇佣了一艘船，将队伍带到阿梅迪奥丛林。使用地图确定海上旅行的时间，取决于冒险者开始旅行的地点，并假设船每天覆盖大约1½个六边形区域。在旅程接近结束时，当船只穿越杰克莱亚湾时，它遭到了一群敌对的萨胡金人的袭击，包括两名萨胡金祭司、六名萨胡金战士和一名水元素。（假设船员避开了这些可怕的怪物，让角色和梅尔奇斯处理这个威胁。）第一阶段在梅尔奇斯和角色划小船上岸时结束。
items.entry: 该怪物没有宝藏堆，但它可能保存有金钱财宝。

items.name: Treasure Theme ({@table 随机魔法物品 - 奥术|XDMG|奥秘}, {@table 每个堡垒都有满足基本需求以及特殊需求的设施，如图书馆、动物园和工坊（参见"{@book 基本设施|XDMG|7|基础设施}"和"{@book 特殊设施|XDMG|7|特殊设施}"）。|XDMG|军备}, {@table 角色们在冒险之间在他们的堡垒中度过7天或更长时间。你可以说，"你有六周时间在你们的堡垒中度过。继续进行并解决六个堡垒回合。"|XDMG|实现}, or {@table 一个特殊设施占据一定的空间（见"{@book 设施空间|XDMG|7|设施空间}"）。玩家可以在堡垒地图上按自己的意愿配置特殊设施的方块。如果其描述中说明，特殊设施可以扩大以提供额外的好处。|XDMG|遗物})
items.ENG_name: Treasure Theme ({@table Random Magic Items - Arcana|XDMG|Arcana}, {@table Random Magic Items - Armaments|XDMG|Armaments}, {@table Random Magic Items - Implements|XDMG|Implements}, or {@table Random Magic Items - Relics|XDMG|Relics})
entries: The monster's treasure hoard features magic items with the noted theme. The {@book 城主指南|XDMG|6|宝藏主题} details treasure hoards appropriate for each theme.

items.name: none
items.entry: 这个怪物不关心宝藏。怪物所拥有的任何宝藏都是偶然的。

entries: Any treasure a monster has is in addition to equipment listed in the Gear entry of its stat block. The {@book 城主指南|XDMG|3|冒险奖励} provides more information on monster treasure.

entries.name: 叙事描述
entries: 在怪物的介绍信息之后，会有适用于该怪物在多元宇宙中任何可能出现的地方的详细信息。根据你的冒险情况适当地自定义这些细节。

entries.name: 特殊巢穴
entries: 一些怪物会改变其巢穴周围的区域。对于这样的怪物，区域效应会在巢穴部分详细说明。怪物的属性块可能还包括怪物在其巢穴中变得更强大的方式。

entries.name: 状态块
entries: 每个条目至少包含一个属性块。属性块将在下一节中详细探讨。

entries.name: 属性区块的部分
entries: The rules for a {@variantrule 资料卡|XPHB} are detailed in the rules glossary of the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} and in this section.

entries.name: 体型
entries: A monster is Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, or Gargantuan. If size options are presented, you choose the creature's size from those options. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|生物体型} for information on size.

entries.name: 生物类型
entries: Each monster has a tag that identifies the type of creature it is. Certain spells, magic items, class features, and other effects in the game interact in special ways with creatures of a particular type. Lists of monsters organized by creature type appear in {@book 附录 B|XMM|3|按生物类型分类的怪物}.
游戏中包含以下生物类型，它们没有自己的特殊规则：

items.name: {@filter 异怪|bestiary|type=异怪}
items.entry: 是完全异类的存在，比如底栖魔鱼、眼魔、浮游灵和夺心魔。

items.name: {@filter 野兽|bestiary|type=野兽}
items.entry: 是非人形的自然生物，例如马和狼，以及大多数巨型动物。

items.name: {@filter 天界生物|bestiary|type=天界语}
items.entry: 是魔法生物，例如天使和飞马，与上层界有着联系。

items.name: {@filter 构装体|bestiary|type=构装体}
items.entry: 是魔法创造的生物，例如人工生命体、魔冢和盾卫者。

items.name: {@filter 龙|bestiary|type=龙}
items.entry: 是有着古老起源的鳞状生物，例如红龙和双足飞龙。

items.name: {@filter 元素生物|bestiary|type=元素生物}
items.entry: 是来自元素位面的生物，例如火巨灵和水元素。

items.name: {@filter 精类|bestiary|type=精类}
items.entry: 是与妖精荒野或自然之力相关的生物，例如树精、哥布林和小精灵。

items.name: {@filter 邪魔|bestiary|type=邪魔}
items.entry: 是那些与恐怖的下界位面紧密相连的生物，比如巴洛魔和地狱犬。

items.name: {@filter 巨人|bestiary|type=巨人}
items.entry: 是拥有类人形态的巨大生物，例如独眼巨人、火巨人和巨魔。

items.name: {@filter 类人生物|bestiary|type=类人生物}
items.entry: 人们由其角色和职业定义，例如法师、海盗和战士。他们包括各种物种的成员。

items.name: {@filter 怪兽|bestiary|type=怪兽}
items.entry: 是一些起源怪异的不自然生物，例如拟形怪和枭熊。

items.name: {@filter 泥怪|bestiary|type=泥怪}
items.entry: 是胶状生物，包括黑布丁和湮灭团块。

items.name: {@filter 植物|bestiary|type=植物}
items.entry: 包括有意识的植被和真菌怪物，如菌人、蹒跚怪和树人。

items.name: {@filter 死灵|bestiary|type=亡灵}
items.entry: 是灵体和不死生物，例如幽灵、吸血鬼和僵尸。

entries.name: 描述性标签
entries: A monster might have one or more tags in parentheses following its type. Such tags provide additional categorization and have no rules of their own, but certain game effects might refer to them. Lists of monster groups related by descriptive tags appear in {@book 附录 B|XMM|3|按群组分类的怪物}.

entries.name: 阵营
entries: 怪物属性栏中指定的阵营是对如何扮演该怪物的默认建议，灵感来自于它在游戏中的传统角色或现实世界中的民间传说。根据你的叙事需求更改怪物的阵营。特别是中立阵营，这是一个邀请，让你考虑个体是否倾向于其他阵营之一。
The {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} describes the {@book 九大阵营|XPHB|2|九大阵营} and {@book 中立生物|XPHB|2|中立生物}.

entries.name: 护甲等级
entries: A monster's {@variantrule 护甲等级|XPHB} (AC) includes its natural armor, Dexterity, gear, and other defenses. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|护甲等级} for information on {@variantrule 护甲等级|XPHB}.

entries.name: 先攻
entries: The {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} entry specifies the monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} modifier followed by the monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} score in parentheses. Use the modifier when you roll to determine a monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}. A monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} modifier is typically equal to its Dexterity modifier, but some monsters have additional modifiers, such as {@variantrule 熟练项|XPHB|熟练加值}, applied to that number.

If you don't want to roll a monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB}, use the {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} score as the monster's {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} in combat. {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} is further detailed in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|先攻}.

entries.name: 生命值
entries: A monster's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} are presented as a number followed by parentheses, where the monster's {@variantrule 生命值骰|XPHB} are provided, along with any contribution from its Constitution. Either use the number for the monster's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or roll the die expression in parentheses to determine the monster's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} randomly; don't use both.
A monster's size typically determines the die used to calculate its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, as shown in the Hit Dice by {@variantrule 体型|XPHB} table.

A monster's Constitution modifier is multiplied by the number of Hit Dice it possesses, and the result is added to its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. For example, if a monster has a Constitution of 12 (+1 modifier) and {@dice 2d8} Hit Dice, it has {@dice 2d8 + 2} {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} (average 11).
For more on {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, see the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB}.

entries.name: 速度
entries: The Speed entry specifies a monster's Speed. Some monsters have one or more of the following speeds: {@variantrule 掘穴速度|XPHB|掘穴}, {@variantrule 攀爬速度|XPHB|攀爬}, {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB|飞行术}, {@variantrule 游泳速度|XPHB|游泳}. Rules for {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} and these specials speeds appear in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|移动}.

entries.name: 属性值
entries: Every monster has six ability scores along with corresponding ability score modifiers and saving throw modifiers. For more information on ability scores and saving throws, see the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|豁免检定}.

entries.name: 技能
entries: The Skills entry specifies a monster's skill proficiencies, if any. For example, a monster that is very perceptive and stealthy might have bonuses to Wisdom ({@skill 察觉|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill 隐匿|XPHB}) checks. A skill bonus is the sum of a monster's relevant ability modifier and its {@variantrule 熟练项|XPHB|熟练加值}. Other modifiers might apply.

entries.name: 抗性和弱点是《Dungeons & Dragons》中描述生物对某些类型伤害的敏感度的机制。如果一个生物对某种伤害类型有抗性（Resistance），那么该类型的伤害会减少一半。如果生物对该伤害类型有弱点（Vulnerability），则受到的伤害会加倍。这些规则在计算总伤害时，是在所有其他伤害加成或减免之后应用的。例如，如果一个生物对钝击伤害有抗性，并且受到25点钝击伤害，同时它还处于一个减少所有伤害5点的魔法光环中，那么首先将25点伤害减少5点，然后再减半，最终生物受到10点伤害。如果生物对同一伤害类型有多个抗性或弱点，它们不会叠加计算，而是只算作一次。例如，如果一个生物对火焰伤害有抗性，同时也对所有非魔法伤害有抗性，那么非魔法火焰伤害对生物的伤害会减半，而不是减少到四分之三。
entries: These entries list a monster's {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB|抗性} and {@variantrule 易伤|XPHB|易伤}, if any. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} for more information.

entries.name: 免疫
entries: This entry lists the monster's {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB|免疫}, if any. If the monster has damage and condition Immunities, the damage types are listed before the conditions. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|1|免疫} for details.

entries.name: 装备
entries: Monsters have proficiency with their equipment. If a monster has equipment that can be given away or retrieved, the items are listed in the Gear entry. The monster's stat block might include special flourishes that happen when the monster uses an item, and the stat block might ignore {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|6|魔法物品} rules for that item. When used by someone else, a retrievable item uses its {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|6|魔法物品} rules, ignoring any special flourishes in the stat block.
装备条目并不一定列出怪物的所有装备。例如，假设一个穿着衣物的怪物穿着得体，而这些衣物并未列在此条目中。
装备条目之外提到的装备被视为超自然或高度专业化，当怪物被击败时无法使用。

entries.name: 弹药与远程攻击
entries: 需要弹药以进行远程攻击的怪物会携带必要的弹药。

entries.name: 为怪物装备其他物品
entries.ENG_name: Equipping a Monster with Other Items
entries: You may equip monsters with additional gear however you like, using the equipment chapter of the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|6} for inspiration. You decide how much of a monster's equipment is recoverable after the creature is slain and whether any of that equipment is still usable.

Beware of giving a monster combat-oriented magic items, since those might alter the monster's {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB}. If you do give a monster a magic item, the monster can have {@variantrule 同调|XPHB} with magic items as noted in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|6|同调}. A monster with a class tag after its creature type is considered a member of that class for {@variantrule 同调|XPHB} purposes.

entries.name: 运行怪物
entries: To ensure a monster acts in accordance with its {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB}, follow these rules during combat:

items.name: 特殊能力
items.entry: 如果怪物有一个特殊能力可以造成大量伤害但使用次数有限，例如可充能的吐息武器或每天只能施放一次的咒语，让它尽快且尽可能频繁地使用那个特殊能力。

items.name: 多重攻击
items.entry: 如果怪物拥有多重攻击能力，在其未使用更强力的能力时，应在其回合中使用多重攻击。

items.name: 额外动作、反应动作、传奇动作
items.entry: 如果该怪物的属性栏中有奖励动作、反应动作或传奇动作，确保它尽可能频繁地使用它们。

entries.name: 感官
entries: The Senses entry specifies a monster's {@variantrule 被动察觉|XPHB} score, as well as any special senses the monster possesses. {@variantrule 被动察觉|XPHB} and {@book 特殊感官|XPHB|1|特殊感官} are described in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB}.

entries.name: 语言
entries: 本条目标列出了怪物可用于交流的语言。有时怪物能理解一种语言但无法使用它进行交流，这会在其条目中注明。"无"表示该生物不懂任何语言。

entries.name: 心灵感应
entries: {@variantrule 心灵感应|XPHB} is a magical ability that allows a creature to communicate mentally with another creature within a specified range. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} for more information.

entries.name: 挑战等级
entries: {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB} is defined in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB|10}, while guidance on using CR to plan potential combat encounters is in the {@book 城主指南|XDMG|3|战斗遭遇}. Lists of monsters organized by {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB} appear in {@book 附录 B|XMM|3|按挑战等级分类的怪物}.

entries.name: 经验值
entries: The number of {@variantrule 经验值|XPHB} (XP) a monster is worth is based on its CR, as detailed in the {@variantrule 经验值|XPHB} by {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB} table. XP is awarded for defeating the monster in combat or otherwise neutralizing it.
除非规则另有说明，否则通过法术或其他魔法能力召唤的怪物的经验值与其状态栏中标注的相同。

entries.caption: 按挑战等级分配的经验点数

entries.name: 熟练加值
entries: A monster's {@variantrule 熟练项|XPHB|熟练加值} (PB) is determined by its CR, as shown in the {@variantrule 熟练项|XPHB|熟练加值} by {@variantrule 挑战等级|XPHB} table, and is reflected in saving throws, skills, and other statistics where the monster's exceptional aptitude is a factor.

entries.caption: 挑战等级对应熟练加值

entries.name: 特性
entries: 怪物的特质，如果有的话，是始终或特定情况下激活的特性。

entries.name: 动作
entries: A monster can take the actions in this section or take one of the {@book 所有生物可用的行动|XPHB|1|动作}, as described in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB}.

entries.name: 攻击表示法
entries: The entry for a monster's attack identifies whether the attack is a melee or a ranged attack and then provides the attack roll's bonus, its reach or range, and what happens on a hit. An attack is against one target unless its entry says otherwise. For details on {@book 不同类型的攻击|XPHB|1|发动攻击}, see the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB}.

entries.name: 命中
entries: 任何因攻击命中目标而造成的伤害或其他效果都在"命中："标记后描述。

entries.name: 未命中
entries: 如果攻击在未命中时有触发效果，该信息将跟随在"未命中："标注之后。

entries.name: 命中或未命中
entries: 如果攻击具有无论是否命中目标都会触发的效果，该信息将跟随在"命中或未命中:"标记之后。

entries.name: 豁免检定表示尝试抵抗法术、陷阱、毒素、疾病或类似威胁。你通常不会选择进行豁免检定；当角色或怪物面临伤害风险时，会被迫进行一次豁免检定。进行豁免检定时，需要投掷一个20面骰（d20）并加上相应的能力修正值。例如，进行敏捷豁免检定时，会使用你的敏捷修正值。豁免检定可能会受到情境加值或减值的修改，并可能受到优势和劣势的影响，由主持人决定。每个职业至少在两项豁免检定中给予熟练度。例如，法师在智力豁免检定中具有熟练度。与技能熟练度一样，对豁免检定的熟练度可以让角色在使用特定能力检定时加上他的熟练加值。一些怪物也具有豁免检定熟练度。豁免检定的难度等级由引起它的效应决定。例如，法术允许的豁免检定的难度等级由施法者的施法能力和熟练加值决定。成功或失败的豁免检定的结果也会在允许豁免的效果中详细说明。通常，成功的豁免意味着生物不受伤害或减少伤害。
entries: 如果一个效果强制进行豁免检定，效果会指出所需的豁免类型，然后提供豁免的DC，描述哪些生物需要进行豁免，并解释豁免失败或成功时会发生什么。
"仅半伤"在豁免成功时意味目标受到的伤害为豁免失败目标的一半（向下取整），同时忽略所有其他效果部分。

entries.name: 伤害表示法
entries: A stat block usually provides both a number and a die expression for each instance of damage. For example, an attack might deal 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) damage on a hit. You decide whether to use the number or the die expression in parentheses; don't use both.

entries.name: 多重攻击
entries: Some creatures can make more than one attack when they take the {@action 攻击|XPHB} action. Such creatures have the Multiattack entry in the "Actions" section of their stat block. This entry details the attacks a creature can make, as well as any additional abilities it can use, as part of the {@action 攻击|XPHB} action.

entries.name: 施法
entries: 如果一个怪物可以施展任何法术，它的状态栏会列出这些法术，并提供怪物的施法能力、法术豁免DC（如果任何法术需要进行豁免检定）和法术攻击加值（如果任何法术需要进行攻击检定）。除非另有说明，否则1级或更高级的法术总是以其最低可能的等级施展，并且不能以更高的等级施展。

A monster's spell can have special rules or restrictions. For example, a {@creature 史拉绿蟾|XMM} can cast the {@spell 隐形术|XPHB} spell, but the spell has a "self only" restriction, which means the spell affects only the slaad.

entries.name: 法术成分
entries: 法术施法特性注明了怪物的法术施法是否忽略了某些法术成分的需求。如果需要任何法术成分，描述怪物使用语言、姿势或材料成分来向角色示意其正在施法。需要材料成分的怪物会拥有这些材料。

entries.name: 施法时间为1分钟以上
entries: If a spell has a casting time of 1 minute or more yet is listed in a spellcasting action, the monster doesn't cast the spell in just one action unless the action's description states otherwise; the monster must take the {@action 魔法|XPHB} action on each of its turns and maintain {@status 专注|XPHB} to cast the spell, as described in the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB}.

entries.name: 附赠动作
entries: If a monster has Bonus Action options, they are listed in this section. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} for details on {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB|附赠动作}.

entries.name: 反应
entries: If the monster has Reaction options, those are listed in this section along with their triggers. See the {@book 玩家手册|XPHB} for details on {@variantrule 反应|XPHB|反应}.

entries.name: 传奇动作
entries: If the monster has Legendary Action options, those are listed in this section. A Legendary Action is an action that a monster can take immediately after another creature's turn. Only one of these actions can be taken at a time and only after another creature's turn ends. The monster can't take a Legendary Action if it has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition or is otherwise unable to take actions.
该怪物拥有的传奇动作使用次数是有限的，该次数在属性栏中有具体说明。每当该怪物使用一个传奇动作时，它将消耗一次使用次数，并在其每回合开始时恢复所有已消耗的使用次数。

entries.name: 限制次数
entries: 状态栏中的某些部分对使用次数有限制。以下是使用限制的最常见方式：

items.name: X/日
entries: This notation means the stat block part can be used a certain number of times (represented by X) and that a monster must finish a {@variantrule 长休|XPHB} to regain expended uses. For example, a {@variantrule 反应|XPHB} that includes "1/Day" means the {@variantrule 反应|XPHB} can be taken once and that the monster must finish a {@variantrule 长休|XPHB} to take it again.

items.name: 充能 X–Y
entries: This notation means a monster can use the stat block part once. At the start of each of the monster's turns, roll {@dice 1d6}. If the roll is within the number range given in the notation (represented by X–Y), the monster regains the use of that part, which also recharges when the monster finishes a {@variantrule 短休|XPHB|短} or {@variantrule 长休|XPHB}. For example, "Recharge 5–6" in an action means a monster can take the action once. Then, at the start of each of the monster's turns, it regains the use of that action if it rolls a 5 or 6 on {@dice 1d6}.

items.name: 短休或长休后重新充能
items.ENG_name: Recharge after a Short or Long Rest
entries: This notation means the monster can use the stat block part once and must then finish a {@variantrule 短休|XPHB|短} or {@variantrule 长休|XPHB} to use it again.

images.title: 封面故事：在这幅由Tyler Jacobson绘制的封面上，冒险者瓦吉拉·萨法尔和明斯克正在与眼魔及其恐怖军团一较高下。他们会证明自己是英雄，还是会成为午餐？
在替代封面上：有什么心事吗？在这幅由奥莱娜·理查兹创作的诡异插画中，一个夺心魔提供了它其中一个吞噬大脑的后代作为替代选择。
